# Knowledge Contract Arcana

> Public research hub for scoped, evidenced knowledge reuse, at contract.place. Part of the Arcanada ecosystem (https://arcanada.ai). The specification and experiments are in progress; 3.0.0-draft.1 is a target, not a released protocol.

- Home: https://contract.place/ (languages: https://contract.place/en/, https://contract.place/ru/, https://contract.place/zh-Hans/; the Chinese interface has not received native editorial review)
- Research (papers): https://contract.place/en/research
- Specifications: https://contract.place/en/docs
- Journal: https://contract.place/en/journal
- Full-document search: https://contract.place/en/search#document-search
- Use and cite (licences): https://contract.place/en/about
- Knowledge Contract repository: https://github.com/Arcanada-one/knowledge-contract
- Site source: https://github.com/Arcanada-one/contract-place-site
- Ecosystem: https://arcanada.ai/
- Architecture article: https://arcanada.ai/en/blog/meaning-management-knowledge-contract-architecture
- Version 2 article: https://arcanada.ai/en/blog/meaning-management-knowledge-contract-v2

## Access

Read-only HTTP API at https://api.contract.place (search, related, fetch over the published documents; schema ContractPlaceRead/v1) and an MCP endpoint at https://api.contract.place/mcp. The site search page calls /v1/search with anonymous GET requests and lists passages in the order the API returns them; it states no relevance threshold.

## Papers

Meaning Management, first release: 14 papers and 10 specifications, published as scientific drafts (concept level). Independent semantic review has not been performed. Russian full texts are the originals; English entry pages are summaries, not translations. Text is CC BY 4.0.

- P00 Foundations of Meaning and Knowledge Management: https://contract.place/en/research/p00 (English entry page), https://github.com/Arcanada-one/knowledge-contract/blob/main/papers/ru/P00_introduction.md (Russian full text)
- P01 Semantic Objects, Sources and Verifiable Extraction: https://contract.place/en/research/p01 (English entry page), https://github.com/Arcanada-one/knowledge-contract/blob/main/papers/ru/P01_semantic_objects_and_extraction.md (Russian full text)
- P02 Context, Depth and Conditions of Applicability: https://contract.place/en/research/p02 (English entry page), https://github.com/Arcanada-one/knowledge-contract/blob/main/papers/ru/P02_context_and_applicability.md (Russian full text)
- P03 Transformations, Composition and Bounded Transfer: https://contract.place/en/research/p03 (English entry page), https://github.com/Arcanada-one/knowledge-contract/blob/main/papers/ru/P03_transformations_and_transfer.md (Russian full text)
- P04 Query, Retrieval and Verifiable Coverage: https://contract.place/en/research/p04 (English entry page), https://github.com/Arcanada-one/knowledge-contract/blob/main/papers/ru/P04_query_retrieval_and_coverage.md (Russian full text)
- P05 Context Composition under a Limited Budget: https://contract.place/en/research/p05 (English entry page), https://github.com/Arcanada-one/knowledge-contract/blob/main/papers/ru/P05_budgeted_context_composition.md (Russian full text)
- P06 Dialogue, Learning and Alignment of Understanding: https://contract.place/en/research/p06 (English entry page), https://github.com/Arcanada-one/knowledge-contract/blob/main/papers/ru/P06_dialogue_and_learning.md (Russian full text)
- P07 Reasoning, Justification and Revision of Conclusions: https://contract.place/en/research/p07 (English entry page), https://github.com/Arcanada-one/knowledge-contract/blob/main/papers/ru/P07_reasoning_and_evidence.md (Russian full text)
- P08 Documents, Representations and Long-Term Memory: https://contract.place/en/research/p08 (English entry page), https://github.com/Arcanada-one/knowledge-contract/blob/main/papers/ru/P08_documents_and_memory.md (Russian full text)
- P09 Knowledge Contract v3: Synthesis of the General Model and a Professional Profile: https://contract.place/en/research/p09 (English entry page), https://github.com/Arcanada-one/knowledge-contract/blob/main/papers/ru/P09_work_roles_skills_and_kc.md (Russian full text)
- P10 Revision of Knowledge, Versions and Acceptance of Norms: https://contract.place/en/research/p10 (English entry page), https://github.com/Arcanada-one/knowledge-contract/blob/main/papers/ru/P10_revision_and_canon.md (Russian full text)
- P11 Evaluation, Counterexamples and the Limits of Claims: https://contract.place/en/research/p11 (English entry page), https://github.com/Arcanada-one/knowledge-contract/blob/main/papers/ru/P11_evaluation_and_falsification.md (Russian full text)
- P12 Knowledge Compilation: Preparing Results and the Admissibility of Reuse: https://contract.place/en/research/p12 (English entry page), https://github.com/Arcanada-one/knowledge-contract/blob/main/papers/ru/P12_compilation_caching_and_reuse.md (Russian full text)
- P13 Knowledge Utility, the Cost of Meaning Artifacts and Resource Management: https://contract.place/en/research/p13 (English entry page), https://github.com/Arcanada-one/knowledge-contract/blob/main/papers/ru/P13_knowledge_utility_and_resource_economics.md (Russian full text)
